name: Capitol Reef National Park
summary: The quietest of Utah's Mighty 5 — a 100-mile wrinkle in the earth, with a pioneer orchard where you can still pick the fruit.

lodging.name: A Torrey lodge
lodging.blurb: Just outside the park's west entrance.

foodMustTry.name: A Gifford House fruit pie
foodMustTry.blurb: Mini pies at the historic Fruita homestead.

days.label: Day 391 — The Waterpocket Fold
days.summary: Orchards, petroglyphs, and a natural bridge.

item.title: Scenic Drive, Fruita orchards & Hickman Bridge
item.blurb: Drive the canyon, pick fruit in the historic Fruita orchards (in season), see the Fremont petroglyphs, and hike to Hickman Bridge.

commute.scenicNote: East across the San Rafael Swell to Moab.
